comparison.objective: Hang two plates or looped parts on separate moving conveyor hooks before a mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Track a moving hook and thread a plate hole or loop onto it before releasing.
comparison.success_condition: Parts hang freely on separate on-time hooks, settled and clear of the robot near the mark.
comparison.reason: The candidate instead preserves a screw-set opening while tightening a jam nut and verifies retention by cycling an articulated gripper; moving-target threading is not tested.
